observed_information: per-stream paired MP4/TXT and NPY/TXT existence
amendment.reason: The first target-blind inventory treated stream-local timestamped capture stems as cross-stream episode identifiers. The released names instead encode one synchronized capture timestamp per stream. Grouping by a 250 ms cross-stream timestamp gap recovers 9-10 physical episodes per object. Two objects retain 12 camera streams in most episodes, so 12 is the minimum complete four-object development panel.

claim_boundary: This amended protocol is a retrospective, target-blind development roster. It can establish synchronized RGB-tactile episode grouping and four-object source-target availability. Because its timestamp grouping and 12-camera threshold were fixed after inspecting name-only coverage from run 33325025964, it cannot be used as fresh or confirmatory evidence. It does not establish model accuracy, calibration, physical-parameter transport, unseen-object generalization, official benchmark parity, or a paper-level result.

eligibility.capture_grouping: single-linkage by trailing capture timestamp across camera and tactile streams
